topic: Plan a road trip route for spring break

scenario.topic: Plan a road trip route for spring break
scenario.opening_question: What matters most for our spring break road trip: scenic routes, budget-friendliness, or reaching a popular destination quickly?

options.name: Beach Getaway
options.upside: Relaxing beach activities and warm weather
options.tradeoff: Long drive and high costs for accommodations
options.best_for: Those prioritizing relaxation and scenic views

options.name: Mountain Adventure
options.upside: Hiking trails, scenic vistas, and a variety of outdoor activities
options.tradeoff: Less comfortable accommodations and variable weather
options.best_for: Those looking for an active, outdoorsy experience

options.name: City Break
options.upside: Cultural attractions, nightlife, and a wide range of dining options
options.tradeoff: Higher costs for food and activities, less relaxation
options.concern: Parking and traffic in the city
options.best_for: Those interested in urban exploration and cultural experiences

options.name: National Parks Tour
options.upside: Visiting multiple iconic national parks and monuments
options.tradeoff: Very long drives between destinations, high overall cost
options.best_for: Those willing to invest time and money for a comprehensive scenic experience
